title: Katlama
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Pani (Water) ½ Cup or as required
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) 1 tbs
Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Zarda ka rang (Yellow food color) ½ tsp
Pani (Water) ½ Cup or as required
Hari moong daal (Green gram) soaked ½ Cup

steps.instruction: In bowl,add all-purpose flour,wheat flour,salt and oil.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,atta,namak aur oil dal dein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and knead well to form a dough,cover & let it rest for 30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ghond ker dough tayyar ker lein,dhak ker 30 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add egg and whisk it,add gram flour,red chili powder,cumin seeds,coriander seeds,salt,yellow food color,water and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein anda dal ker whisk ker lein,baisan,lal mirch powder,zeera,dhania,namak,zadra ka rang aur pani dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and mix well to make a thick paste.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur mix ker ka garha paste tayyar ker lein.

steps.instruction: Grease your hands with oil and knead dough again,take a small dough,make a ball and sprinkle flour and roll out dough with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: Haathon ko oil sa grease karein aur chota dough la ker ball bana lein,atta chirak dein aur dough ko rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein.

steps.instruction: Spread prepared paste,sprinkle dried pomegranate seeds and green gram.
steps.romanUrdu: Prepared paste ko dal ker pheela lein,anardana aur hari moong daal dal dein.

steps.instruction: In wok,heat oil and fry until golden brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein oil garam karein aur golden brown hunay tak fry ker lein.

ogDescription: Katlama is Lahore's most wanted street food which is also famous all over the world. Let's make it at home like we do and you will love it. #HappyCookingToYou
